# Completeness findings accepted as pre-existing for one locale, one key per
# line (check-completeness.py finding_key). A RATCHET, not a target: the
# sieve's measured precision is ~12%, so most of these are fine. A change may
# not ADD a finding unnoticed. Shrink it by fixing real defects; add to it
# with --accept-new after reading each new finding. One file per locale, so
# rounds on different locales never conflict here.
